run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:30:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by the frontend's own failing /api/data requests: frontend ERROR spans start at 02:30:37Z, peak at 4.41 spans/s (02:39:37) and are confined to GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, GET and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (plus a small tcp.connect error rate), while cart and checkout operations show no errors. The ad dependency is the cause of those failures: the ad Deployment (desired 1 replica) now has 0 available/ready replicas, its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 cannot create a pod because ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory forbids it ("requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m"), the ad Endpoints object has no subsets, and ad's own span rate for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds decays from ~1.0-1.13/s at 02:29:37 to 0 from 02:35:37 onward. The quota object otel-demo-memory was created at 02:29:25Z with a hard memory limit of 1503238553600m (1.4Gi) while the 20 already-running otel-demo pods already request exactly 1901Mi, so its own status shows used above hard. Ten seconds after the quota appeared, the ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w was stopped and the Deployment scaled its ReplicaSet 1->0 and back to 1, after which every pod-creation attempt was rejected by the quota. All other 20 otel-demo Deployments report available=ready=1, all 20 existing pods are ready with 0 restarts, and all 5 nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False, so the impact is confined to the ad dependency and its frontend /api/data path. What deleted the ad pod / scaled the Deployment is not identifiable from the available evidence (change history is not integrated), so the conclusion is partial while the blocking object is clear.

claims.text: Frontend ERROR span rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) is 0 at every sampled minute up to 02:29:37Z, then 0.50/s at 02:30:37Z, rises to a maximum of 4.41/s at 02:39:37Z and is 1.18/s at 02:42:37Z; the UNSET series is 13.9/s at the start of the series and 15.1/s at 02:42:37Z.
At 02:35:00Z the frontend has 3.47 spans/s with status STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 39.55 spans/s with STATUS_CODE_UNSET (span counts, not request counts).

The frontend's ERROR spans are concentrated on the /api/data path: GET /api/data, GET, executing api route (pages) /api/data and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds all follow the same curve (first non-zero 0.119/s at 02:30:37Z, peak 1.10/s at 02:39:37Z, 0.293/s at 02:42:37Z), while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder remain 0; tcp.connect shows 0.026-0.048/s of errors from 02:30:37Z.

Events in namespace otel-demo show: Pod ad-554b849958-p226w Killing "Stopping container ad" at 02:29:35Z; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete of that pod at 02:29:35Z; Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0" at 02:29:35Z; Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1" at 02:29:45Z; and 10 Warning FailedCreate events on ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (one aggregated event with count 8 at 02:35:13Z) each reading: pods "ad-554b849958-*" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m.

Deployment otel-demo/ad has spec.replicas=1, status.unavailableReplicas=1 and no ready/available replicas; its conditions are Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable, lastTransitionTime 02:29:45Z) and ReplicaFailure=True (FailedCreate) with the message pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m. Its container ad (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) requests memory 225Mi and limits 450Mi.
ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory has metadata.creationTimestamp 2026-11-18T02:29:25Z, spec.hard memory=1503238553600m and status.hard memory=1503238553600m with status.used memory=1901Mi.

The 20 pods currently in otel-demo have memory requests of 160Mi, 55Mi, 128Mi, 4Mi, 50Mi, 120Mi+250Mi, 200Mi, 100Mi, 25Mi, 5Mi, 300Mi, 100Mi, 150Mi, 80Mi, 50Mi, 15Mi, 20Mi, 80Mi, 5Mi and 4Mi, which sum to 1901Mi - exactly the quota's status.used - and no pod belongs to the ad ReplicaSet.

The Endpoints object ad in otel-demo has no subsets (no addresses); Service ad selects opentelemetry.io/name=ad on port 8080 with targetPort 8080, and Deployment ad's pod template carries label opentelemetry.io/name=ad and containerPort 8080 named service.

The ad service's own span activity stops: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is 0.80-1.13/s from 02:20:37Z through 02:29:37Z, then 0.796/s at 02:31:37Z, 0.356/s at 02:33:37Z and 0/s from 02:35:37Z through 02:42:37Z; getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds follow the same decay to 0. At 02:40:00Z every ad span series (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds, flagd ResolveBoolean/EventStream, resolve) reads 0.
ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owned by Deployment ad) has spec.replicas=1 with readyReplicas and availableReplicas absent, i.e. no ad pod was running at query time.

Of the 21 Deployments in otel-demo, only ad lacks availability (available null, unavailable 1, ReplicaFailure); the other 20, including frontend (available 1, ready 1) and frontend-proxy, report Available=True with MinimumReplicasAvailable. All 20 listed otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState.
At 02:40:00Z the ERROR span rate by service is frontend 2.70/s and frontend-proxy 1.40/s, while recommendation, ad, payment, accounting and fraud-detection each read 0/s.

The events returned for the authorized window across all namespaces group into 19 kind/namespace/reason groups and contain no Pod reason Evicted or OOMKilling; the only otel-demo Pod events are the ad pod's Killing (Stopping container ad) plus the ad ReplicaSet/Deployment scale events and FailedCreate warnings.
All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False at query time.

The frontend's RequestErrorRate is the consequence of its /api/data route's client calls to AdService/GetAds failing because the ad service has no endpoints: the ad Deployment's only pod was stopped at 02:29:35Z, the ReplicaSet was scaled back to 1 at 02:29:45Z, and every replacement pod is rejected by ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory, so no ad pod exists and the ad Endpoints object has no subsets.

frontend-proxy's 1.40/s ERROR span rate (operations ingress and router frontend egress) is a downstream consequence of the frontend returning errors on /api/data; its per-response status codes were not read, so this link is unverified.

The decisive change was the creation of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 02:29:25Z with a hard memory limit (1503238553600m, i.e. 1.4Gi) below the 1901Mi already requested by the namespace's existing pods: without that quota the ad pod deleted at 02:29:35Z would have been recreated by its ReplicaSet, as happened with unchanged pod template and revision 1, instead of staying down for the whole observed window.

Node-level memory or disk pressure evicting the ad pod is rejected: all nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure=False and DiskPressure=False, the ad pod's removal appears as a graceful Killing ("Stopping container ad") at the same second as the Deployment's ScalingReplicaSet 1->0 event, and no Pod Evicted or OOMKilling reason appears in the events returned for the window.

A Service selector or port mismatch on Service ad is rejected: the selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad and targetPort 8080 match the Deployment's pod template label opentelemetry.io/name=ad and containerPort 8080 (name service); the Endpoints object is empty only because no ad pod exists.

A flagd fault flag (e.g. adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc) as the explanation is rejected as far as observable: the stored demo.flagd.json in ConfigMap flagd-config currently has defaultVariant "off"/"0" for all flags including the ad-related ones, and a service-level error flag cannot explain the absence of an ad pod and the quota-forbidden pod creation that the Deployment status reports.

Raise the memory hard limit of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (or lower the requests of pods in otel-demo) so that the namespace's committed requests plus the ad container's 225Mi fit: the current hard limit 1503238553600m (1.4Gi) is already below the 1901Mi requested by existing pods, so no ad pod can be admitted until it is changed.

Identify, via Kubernetes audit logs or a change-history source, who created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 2026-11-18T02:29:25Z and who set Deployment ad's replica count to 0 and back to 1 at 02:29:35Z/02:29:45Z; those records are not available in this run.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this run, so the actor and reason behind the creation of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 2026-11-18T02:29:25Z and behind the ad Deployment scale-down/scale-up at 02:29:35Z-02:29:45Z are unknown; that trigger remains a gap.

The exact gRPC error returned to the frontend when calling oteldemo.AdService/GetAds was not read: Jaeger returned spans only for about 02:28:51-02:28:53Z in the 02:25-02:40Z frontend search (246 spans, RESULT_TOO_LARGE, not read back) and searches in 02:31-02:32Z returned no traces, and a traces_search_by_tags for operation grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with error=true returned no data, so the failure is attributed from operation-level error spans and ad's endpoint/deployment state, not from the error message.

The frontend container's logs for 02:30-02:46Z returned no lines at all (bytes_read 0, no lines read for either instance), so application-log confirmation of the /api/data failure was not obtained; the ad pod's logs are unavailable because the pod no longer exists.

The Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (no_data for rule_name=RequestErrorRate) and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count had no series in 02:20-02:46Z (get_all_labels no_data), so the alert's exact expression and metric pipeline could not be reproduced or verified in this run.

Whether the frontend's declining ERROR span rate after 02:41:37Z reflects partial recovery or reduced load (the UNSET rate also falls from 51.1/s to 15.1/s) is unknown; the ad Deployment was still unavailable when last read.
next_steps: Compare the memory hard limit of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory with the namespace's actual committed requests and restore headroom (advisory; no change was made here).
Look up the Kubernetes audit log/change record for the ResourceQuota creation at 2026-11-18T02:29:25Z and for the Deployment ad scale operations at 02:29:35Z and 02:29:45Z.

Confirm on a recovering pod that AdService/GetAds and /api/data error spans return to zero after the ad pod is admitted, and inspect the frontend access logs for /api/data response codes during 02:29-02:46Z.
